findings.summary: Y5's worker guard is a source-string match, which spec §4.1 forbids outright ("源码字符串匹配一律不构成证据"). The test reads src/tick.ts with readFileSync and asserts /const runId = randomUUID()/. This evaluates no behavior: hoisting the worker's randomUUID() out of the dispatch loop in src/tick.ts:416 while any line matching that regex remains anywhere in the file leaves the test green, so it cannot be the regression guard Y5 requires.

Y5's triage guard asserts against a runtime object the test itself constructs, so it can never fail on a production regression. The test literally writes `runId: randomUUID()` into a hand-built TriageSpawnRuntime and then asserts that object has `runId` and lacks `newRunId`. It never touches the production triage assembly at src/tick-run.ts:1534-1568, and Y4 explicitly disqualifies self-built runtime injection ("自建 runtime 注入的用例不算数").

The Y7 reachability declaration for Y5 is false. It names the two cases above as the unique tests that fail when triage/worker run-id generation regresses, and asserts each "必挂". Neither can fail on a regression of the guarded production paths: one asserts on a test-local literal, the other on file text. Spec §2 Y7 requires a declaration a reviewer can verify by reading code, and this one does not hold.

Hard acceptance criterion Y8 is still not delivered; the same defect was raised in the prior final review (rf-attempt_01KZMTZ3YSDSGHNVPFAAXJ118Q) and was not fixed. Spec §2 Y8 requires `git status --porcelain` output to be pasted, and §2 declares the table 缺一不可. The dev-note carries an empty fenced block plus the prose claim "提交后工作区清洁", which is an assertion rather than the required pasted evidence.

The dev-note records input_commit as e2b8c104a65c581fd4a0ae688c247c57e10ac648, which is not this attempt's input_commit. Spec §4.3 requires the dev-note to record the input_commit of the attempt dd handed to the implementer; the rework attempt attempt_01KZMW0CN7BEPFM569YJXRJBDH carries input_commit bed307241bcf9698a2d3aca1e1159495cd250f45.

The core G10 fix itself is correct and complete: GenerateSpawnRuntime.runId is replaced by the newRunId() factory, spawnGenerateRole calls it exactly once per spawn and threads the identical value into both buildGenerateRoleArgv and readBody (satisfying Y2 as an independent criterion), production assembly wires newRunId: () => randomUUID(), and no dangling generate-side runId reference remains in src or test. Y1-Y4 are met; only the Y5/Y7/Y8 evidence obligations block approval.
